items.title: When it came to Cal AI’s viral success, a small army of influencers paid off
items.summary: The company generated over $30 million in revenue in two years and was acquired by MyFitnessPal for an undisclosed amount of money in March.

items.title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
items.summary: Meta and Apple have teamed up for the launch of the social media giant's newest model, Muse Spark Open, which will run locally on Apple silicon.

items.title: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay sees a future where AI devices replace the need to use apps
items.summary: Speaking at TechCrunch Disrupt, Amazon devices chief Panos Panay described a future where ambient AI devices work in the background, anticipating users' needs instead of waiting for commands.

items.title: Anthropic is letting METR researchers look under the hood with employee-level access
items.summary: METR will publish its own assessments of Anthropic’s risks, incidents, and practices, and the frontier AI model maker has given up the right to block them.

items.title: Bluesky expands its AI-powered Attie app to let anyone build websites, games, and more
items.summary: Bluesky is bringing “social vibe coding” to its experimental Attie platform, allowing users to create interactive experiences like games, quizzes, and websites that can tap into the social network's audience.

items.summary: We'll likely learn more about how this will work at the company's upcoming "AI & Autonomy Day" event in December.

items.title: Google’s Universal Cart shopping tool launches in the US
items.summary: The new shopping tool is available in the U.S. across Google Search and the Gemini app.

items.title: Amazon’s Bee launches two new personal AI devices, starting at $75
items.summary: Amazon-owned Bee has launched its first new AI devices since its acquisition, including an updated wearable and a credit-card-sized recorder that attaches to smartphones. The devices can summarize conversations, create to-do lists, and integrate with Alexa and Amazon shopping, with prices starting at $74.99.

items.title: Figma announces new features to define how agents work on its platform
items.summary: Figma is also releasing its code layers feature in open beta.

items.title: Ricursive Intelligence is betting on AI-designed chips to help solve the compute crisis
items.summary: The founders detailed how their startup is developing AI that can design chips, learn from each iteration, and improve subsequent designs, all with the goal of automating and accelerating the chip design process.

items.title: Gudea leverages AI to help organizations prevent social media crises before they erupt
items.summary: Gudea, a company that tracks how stories and rumors spread online that describes itself as the “storm tracker for the internet,” is using AI to help organizations spot trouble brewing online before it turns into a crisis.

items.title: Flock CEO says its microphones detect ‘just gunshots’ — its website says different
items.summary: Langley’s comments come amid mounting scrutiny of Flock from privacy advocates, including the ACLU, and members of the public who are concerned about the misuse of its technology.

items.title: YouTube Music launches new labels as AI-generated music floods streaming platforms
items.summary: The label will appear on the player page and include songs entirely generated by AI or partially, such as AI involved in composition and vocals.

items.title: Apate sends AI agents undercover to get scammed so they can gather fraud intelligence
items.summary: Most companies use AI agents to ship products faster or speed up workflows. Apate.ai sends them undercover to get scammed.

items.title: Deezer will soon let you filter out AI-generated music
items.summary: Deezer said that the new toggle will be rolled out by the end of the year.

items.title: Zenzap raises $44M for its AI chat app that aims to replace WhatsApp in the workplace
items.summary: Zenzap is used by organizations including Starbucks and Taco Bell.

items.title: Floqer’s AI agents research sales prospects so teams don’t have to
items.summary: The problem Floqer is trying to solve is familiar to anyone who has worked in sales or revenue operations.
